name: codexy-devtools
description: Optional Codegraph impact, check-recommendation, LSP, and MCP scenario-testing integrations for Codexy.

interface.shortDescription: Add Codegraph, LSP, and installed MCP scenario testing to Codexy.
interface.longDescription: Codexy Devtools provides optional local Codegraph structure, read-only change-impact and advisory check-recommendation tools, language-server integrations, and an installed CLI and skill for trusted local MCP scenario runs and comparisons for a separately installed Codexy core.
defaultPrompt: Use $codegraph for search, dependency navigation, impact, and check advice when Devtools is installed.
Use $lsp for optional language-aware diagnostics, symbols, definitions, references, and bounded batches.
Use $mcp-test to run or compare trusted local MCP scenarios with explicit chaining and expectations.
